simple.summary: אֱלִיפָל (ʼĔlîyphâl) means Eliphal , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 35.

definitions.full: H465. Eliphal אֱלִיפָל proper name, masculine ( God has judged ) one of David's heroes 1Chr 11:35 (but see אֱלִיפֶלֶט 2Sam 23:34 ).
